links.comparator_used: No AI-alone arm. Clinician decisions after unsafe AI recommendations were compared with decisions after safe ones, and with their own pre-AI plans.
links.outcome: Rejection of unsafe versus safe AI drug recommendations by clinicians making the final prescribing decision
links.effect: 92% of clinicians rejected unsafe AI recommendations vs 29% of safe ones; +37% gaze fixations on unsafe vs safe AI recommendations
links.tradeoff: Visual attention on AI explanations was not greater in unsafe scenarios. Clinicians did not look back at the patient monitor or chart after an unsafe AI reveal. Scripted nurse comments changed the dose only 5% of the time. 29% of safe recommendations were also rejected.
links.quote: 92% of clinicians rejected unsafe AI recommendations vs 29% of safe ones.

design_hint: clinician review of AI recommendations (human oversight)
